anomalies.description: A large group of people is engaged in chaotic, violent unrest on a street; individuals are running, pushing, and clashing, with smoke (likely tear gas) deployed starting around frame f7 (3.5s), causing widespread dispersal and panic.

Multiple pairs of individuals are seen in close physical confrontation: in f0, a man in blue shirt is grabbed by another; in f2–f4, men are shoving and grappling near a motorcycle; these appear to be mutual physical combats rather than one-sided attacks.

A chaotic street scene with multiple individuals running, smoke (likely tear gas) being deployed, and police in riot gear advancing. Vehicles including white vans (some marked 'HALKET' or similar, possibly security/medical) are present amid the unrest. The sequence shows sustained collective violent unrest involving confrontation between civilians and law enforcement.

In frames f13–f15, a group of police officers in riot gear is seen physically restraining and lifting an individual (visible at center in f14–f15), indicating mutual physical struggle or forced apprehension consistent with fighting during a riot.

A large group of riot police in helmets and shields advances toward a crowd of civilians on a narrow urban street, forming a tight line and engaging in direct confrontation; the crowd appears to be resisting or being pushed back, with visible tension and physical proximity indicating collective violent unrest.

A sustained confrontation between a crowd of civilians and a line of riot police in white helmets and transparent shields, with visible pushing and tension; the scene escalates to include a water cannon vehicle labeled 'ÇEVİK KUVVET' arriving at 23.0s.
